messages.context: Zog 新手流程实测台词（第 1 条）
messages.raw: §fHello! Have you heard of pet items?
messages.text: Hello! Have you heard of pet items?
messages.zh: 你好! 你听说过宠物道具吗?

messages.context: Zog 新手流程实测台词（第 2 条）
messages.text: Pet items give your companions bonuses!
messages.zh: 宠物道具能为你的伙伴提供加成!

messages.context: Zog 新手流程实测台词（第 3 条）
messages.raw: §fI sell all kinds of them if you'd like to try one out!
messages.text: I sell all kinds of them if you'd like to try one out!
messages.zh: 我这里各式各样的都有,想试试的话就来买吧!

messages.text: ✆ You know %s, I'm a pet lover.
messages.zh: ✆ 你知道吗 %s,我是个宠物迷。

messages.text: ✆ So my abiphone contacts list is FILLED with TONS of other pet lovers.
messages.zh: ✆ 所以我的 Abiphone 通讯录里塞满了一大堆宠物迷。

messages.text: ✆ I don't want to sound too gamey but...
messages.zh: ✆ 我不想显得太像在打游戏,不过……

messages.text: ✆ If you had 5 Max Lvl pets of Legendary tier or better in your pet menu...
messages.zh: ✆ 要是你的宠物菜单里有 5 只满级的传说或更高稀有度的宠物……

messages.text: ✆ That would show me you're a pet lover too!
messages.zh: ✆ 那就说明你也是个宠物迷!

messages.text: ✆ Wow, you're a true pet lover!
messages.zh: ✆ 哇,你是货真价实的宠物迷!

messages.text: ✆ You doubled my HUGE contacts list too!
messages.zh: ✆ 你还让我那“庞大”的通讯录翻了一倍!

messages.text: ✆ Now there's both Kat AND you!
messages.gloss: 笑点:所谓庞大的通讯录其实只有 Kat 一个人。
messages.zh: ✆ 现在里面有 Kat,还有你了!
